`clever drain create betterstack <url> --api-key <source-token>` is now accepted, but the API type code `BETTERSTACK` is a guess. Nothing in the repo or in `@clevercloud/client` mentions Better Stack, so I couldn't confirm it. I didn't create a drain, so the real API hasn't accepted it yet. If the API uses a different code, change `apiCode` in `src/models/drain.js`.

**Behaviour:**
- `betterstack` is a new drain type, labelled "Better Stack" in `clever drain get`.
- It works like `newrelic`: `--api-key` is required and is sent as the recipient's `apiKey`. I assumed the Better Stack source token goes there. Check that against what the API expects.
- Changes are in `src/models/drain.js` (the new type) and `src/commands/drain/drain.create.command.js` (the `--api-key` handling).
- I added a "Better Stack logs drains" section to `docs/services-logs-drains.md` and updated the generated command docs.

`npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate` pass. I had to run `npm ci` first because dependencies weren't installed.

Prettier also reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, so I reverted that file.
